areas: Annapolis, Baltimore, Washington, D.C., Northern Virginia

hero.eyebrow: Projects featured in Annapolis Home Magazine and Architectural Digest
hero.sub: Tunable color temperature, keypad scenes set for how you live, and voice control. Light that follows your day, and a calmer home.

items.p: Engraved buttons, each one a scene: mornings, entertaining, bedtime. Finishes to match the room.
Cool light through the day, warm light at night, so the house follows your rhythm.
Square or round, two inch or three inch, recessed, pendants, and sconces.

about.p: Performance Home Automation designs and installs lighting control for new construction, renovations, and existing homes. One team takes it from the first design through installation, programming, testing, and support.
about.alt: Seven of the Performance Home Automation team in company shirts at a trade show

steps.p: We settle the layout, where each fixture goes, and how every space is controlled.
A lighting plan on paper before fixtures, wiring, and ceilings are final.
Wired, installed, programmed, and tested by one team.
Tuned once the home is lived in, and supported after.

items.p: We have been working with PHA for almost six years on various home electronics projects and couldn't recommend them more.

PHA was fabulous during my home renovation. We automated Lutron lighting throughout the house, built in sonos speakers and security cameras, all operated from the phone. They also installed a ring doorbell, where no doorbell existed. They are reliable, reasonable and professional.
PHA is great. They do all my Ledo Pizza restaurants from security, AV systems and cameras. Their service techs are always available to come troubleshoot and fix our issues within 24 hours!

final.p: Tell us about your home and pick a time on our calendar.

form.hint: A line or two is plenty: the rooms, new build or a retrofit, the fixtures you have in mind.
